- **Sleep stayed fairly stable, with a small upward shift.** The average moved from about **7.1 hours** in week one to **7.3 hours** in week two.
- **Hydration also edged up.** Water intake increased from about **2.1 liters** per day to **2.2 liters** per day on average.
- **Best overall day:** **2025-08-14** — highest steps, sleep, and water all in one day.
- **Pattern to notice:** the second week looks stronger across all three habits, which may mean your routine became more consistent.
